query:
SELECT DISTINCT
                 CASE WHEN a.shared_inbox_url IS NOT NULL AND a.shared_inbox_url <> ''
                      THEN a.shared_inbox_url
                      ELSE a.inbox_url
                 END AS inbox
               FROM follows f
               JOIN accounts a ON a.id = f.account_id
               WHERE f.target_account_id = $1
                 AND a.domain IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol = 1
                 AND a.inbox_url <> ''
